title: Control Volume System
text: 带传热的定容开放热力学系统，输入 4 路、输出 2 路；按 {Heat transfer model} 指定模型；{Number of inlet ports} 指定端口数、{Number of outlet ports} 指定端口数、{Image type} 指定图标颜色 Cold、{Chamber volume, Vch} 指定体积、{Initial chamber pressure, Pinit} 指定压力、{Initial chamber temperature, Tinit} 指定温度、{Ideal gas constant, R} 指定理想气体常数、{Specific heat capacity, cp} 指定比热、{Heat transfer rate, q_he} 指定速率、{External convection heat transfer coefficient, ext_tbl} 指定歧管外部空气、{External velocity breakpoints, ext_bpts} 指定歧管外部空气 linspace、{External convection area, Aext_conv} 指定歧管外部空气、{Thermal mass, m_wall} 指定歧管壁面通用、{Wall heat capacity, cp_wall} 指定歧管壁面通用、{Initial mass temperature, Tmass} 指定歧管壁面通用、{External wall thickness, Dext_cond} 指定歧管壁面外部、{External conduction area, Aext_cond} 指定歧管壁面外部、{External wall thermal conductivity, kext} 指定歧管壁面外部、{Internal wall thickness, Dint_cond} 指定歧管壁内部、{Internal conduction area, Aint_cond} 指定歧管壁内部、{Internal wall thermal conductivity, kint} 指定歧管壁内部、{Internal convection heat transfer coefficient, int_tbl} 指定歧管内空气、{Internal mass flow rate breakpoints, int_bpts} 指定歧管内空气 linspace、{Internal flow convection area, Aint_conv} 指定歧管内空气，按实例取值。
